name: permission-dialog
notes: The FIRST overlay in Z-order, drawn before every other. assert_screen pins the ► marker on '[y] Yes, allow once' so a regression that flips the default from Allow to Deny — the most consequential default in the whole TUI — shows up as a text diff rather than a silent behaviour change. The needle stops at 'Yes' because evaluate_screen_assertions splits clauses on ',' and the full option label contains one. Reachable since MockAgentEvent grew a permission_request variant: run_headless already creates the permission_tx/rx pair and App::run already drains it into this dialog, so the mock path just sends on the same channel with_permissions() would.
